intent: Make the divider dominant and interrupt any apparent mirrored route. The visual comparison must retain the explicit distinction between agent behavior and human institutional responsibility.
source:
**Frame:** A hard black divider breaks the symmetry. Text crosses neither side.

**Caption:**
> THESE ARE NOT THE SAME ACTORS.
>
> THEY DO NOT HAVE THE SAME DUTIES, KNOWLEDGE, OR MORAL RESPONSIBILITY.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — explicit anti-equivalence statement.
title: A hard divider interrupts the apparent symmetry
